title: Transitivity of Constrained Reachability
statement: Fix a program, oracle, input, and predicate $G$ on configurations. If there is a finite run from $a$ to $b$ and a finite run from $b$ to $c$, with every configuration before each run's endpoint satisfying $G$, then there is a finite run from $a$ to $c$ with every configuration before its endpoint satisfying $G$.
hypotheses_covered: Reachability from $a$ to $b$, with $G$ holding at every earlier configuration
Reachability from $b$ to $c$, with $G$ holding at every earlier configuration
